context_for_next_testing_agent: SMC v5 (5-point ТЗ) fully tested and verified. Key implementation details: (1) Entry Engine has exactly 4 gates: Gate 1 = 4H trend filter (htf_4h_trend param), Gate 2 = liquidity sweep mandatory, Gate 3 = FVG/OB zone retest, Gate 4 = RR >= min_rr_ratio. No 15M checks, no volume gates, no SMC score gates. (2) Whitelist-only mode: get_trade_symbols in main.py returns only whitelist_symbols when whitelist_enabled=true. (3) config.yaml has early_exit_bars=0, min_rr_ratio=2.5, whitelist_symbols=[BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT, LINKUSDT, BNBUSDT]. (4) LiquidityHeatmap module detects real orderbook bid/ask walls and calculates liquidity magnet direction.
